title: checkUnitContracts
responsibility: Compares stored contracts with indexed source and state inventories, reporting located heuristic gaps and per-entity totals without rewriting contracts.

inputs.name: checkUnitContracts.id
inputs.description: Registered active identity; undefined selects all only when the options explicitly request all.

inputs.name: checkUnitContracts.options
inputs.description: Project root and optional additional required-state JSON paths. Guide reads HEAD; contract checks read the working tree. all selects every active stored contract.

inputs.name: renderContractCheck.report
inputs.description: Completed structured report to render without recomputing source or upgrading proof.

outputs.name: checkUnitContracts
outputs.description: Selected active entities, located finding records, per-entity counts and total findings. Findings are heuristic, not exhaustive proof.

outputs.name: renderContractCheck
outputs.description: Human per-entity counts followed by each finding kind, detail, location and total.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid selection, unknown identities, malformed inventories or invalid registry data with the specific CLI diagnostic.

errors.name: Dependency failure
errors.description: Propagates Git, filesystem, source-reader and evidence-validation failures from the invoked operation.
